# Style rules

## Naming

Keep React components under two hundred lines and extract hooks early. Keep React components under two hundred lines and extract hooks early. Public functions carry doc comments describing units and failure modes. Public functions carry doc comments describing units and failure modes.

- When adding a dependency, explain the alternative you rejected in the PR.
- Error messages are written for the on-call engineer at three in the morning.

## Imports

Use the shared logger instead of console.log in application code. Keep React components under two hundred lines and extract hooks early. When adding a dependency, explain the alternative you rejected in the PR. Prefer small, focused functions and name them after what they return.

- Database migrations must be reversible and reviewed by a second engineer.
- API handlers validate input with the schema library and return typed errors.
